recipes.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: A simple Neapolitan-style pizza with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
instructions: Preheat your oven to its highest setting with a pizza stone inside.
Stretch the dough into a 10-inch round on a floured surface.
Spread crushed tomatoes over the base, leaving a border for the crust.
Tear the mozzarella and distribute evenly, then drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 7-9 minutes until the crust is blistered and golden.
Top with fresh basil and a pinch of salt before serving.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
recipes.description: Fragrant coconut curry with tender chicken, Thai basil, and crisp vegetables.
instructions: Fry the curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until it changes color.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the vegetables and cook until just tender.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar, then stir through the basil.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Spinach Stew
recipes.description: A hearty, budget-friendly vegan stew with warming spices and plenty of greens.
instructions: Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat.
Stir in the paprika and cumin and toast for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted.
Season to taste and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef Bolognese
recipes.description: A slow-simmered Italian ragu rich with beef, tomatoes, and red wine.
instructions: Sweat the onion, carrot, and celery until soft.
Increase the heat and brown the beef thoroughly.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with red wine and let it reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes, then simmer gently for at least 90 minutes.
Toss with cooked tagliatelle and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Avocado & Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Fresh, zesty tacos layered with smoky black beans and creamy avocado.
instructions: Warm the black beans with smoked paprika and a splash of water.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Char the tortillas directly over a flame or in a dry pan.
Layer beans and avocado onto each tortilla.
Top with red onion and cilantro and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
recipes.description: A whole roast chicken with bright lemon, garlic, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C (400F).
Rub the chicken all over with butter, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
Roast for about 75 minutes, basting halfway through.
Rest for 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.description: A no-cook breakfast of creamy oats soaked overnight and topped with berries.
instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and honey in a jar.
Stir well and seal the jar.
Refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Top with fresh berries before eating.

recipes.title: Spicy Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crispy tofu tossed with crunchy vegetables in a fiery garlic-chili sauce.
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then cube it.
Fry the tofu in vegetable oil until golden on all sides.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and chili garlic sauce to coat.
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burger
recipes.description: A juicy homemade beef burger with melted cheese and all the trimmings.
instructions: Divide the beef into 4 patties and season generously.
Sear in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side.
Add a slice of cheese to each patty and let it melt.
Toast the buns lightly.
Assemble with lettuce, tomato, and onion and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: A creamy, comforting risotto with mixed mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Saute the mushrooms until golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion in butter, then add the rice and toast briefly.
Deglaze with white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
When the rice is creamy and al dente, stir in mushrooms and parmesan.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki Bowl
recipes.description: Glazed salmon over rice with edamame and a glossy teriyaki sauce.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, mirin, and honey into a glaze.
Sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp.
Flip, add the glaze, and spoon over the fish until sticky.
Serve over rice with edamame and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: A crisp, refreshing salad with cucumber, tomato, olives, and feta.
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.
Top with a slab of feta.
Toss gently at the table and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy flourless pancakes sweetened naturally with ripe banana.
instructions: Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Cook spoonfuls in a buttered pan until bubbles form.
Flip and cook until golden.
Serve with maple syrup and extra banana.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: A nourishing bowl of roasted veg, quinoa, and lemon-tahini dressing.
instructions: Roast the sweet potato, chickpeas, and onion with olive oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Whisk the tahini and lemon juice with a little water into a dressing.
Assemble the quinoa and roasted vegetables in a bowl.
Drizzle with the lemon-tahini dressing and serve.
